sloka: स तेन सह संयुक्तः पावकेन अनिलो यथा ।श्रीमान् राज वरः तेन जनस्थानम् निपातितम् ॥३-३१-१७॥
transliteration: sa tena saha saṁyuktaḥ pāvakena anilo yathā ।śrīmān rāja varaḥ tena janasthānam nipātitam ॥3-31-17॥

translations.english: Rama is prosperous. He is the best among kings. Lakshmana with him is like wind with fire. Rama has pulled down Janasthana.
